comment: The text presents FHIR profiles as representations derived from a technology-independent logical model. While this is a sound modelling approach, many FHIR profiles are authored directly from requirements without a separate formal logical model.

anchor.note: p.96 l.Lines 313-321 read as the printed page; section 4.3.3 agrees

public.text: The text presents FHIR profiles as representations derived from a technology-independent logical model. While this is a sound modelling approach, many FHIR profiles are authored directly from requirements without a separate formal logical model.
public.suggestedRevision: Present derivation from governed logical models as the preferred national approach rather than an inherent property of all FHIR profiling.
